summary: Hidden probe metering allocated to stale org ledger, resulting in missing warmup credits on invoice
description:
Issue summary: Customer reports that their March invoice is missing expected hourly warmup credits for a production batch warmstart window. The console shows the warmup events occurred, and the postback timeline indicates successful ingest, but credits are not visible on the org invoice.

Impact: NimbleHealth reports a $6,800 provisional discrepancy on their finalized invoice. This affects a large enterprise account on reserved capacity over the month window and is blocking autopay for the invoice.

Environment: prod, us-east region, reserved-dedicated pool (pool-id: ded-us-east-02).

Steps to reproduce / evidence:
1) Run scheduled batch job that triggers warmstart probe events (customer provided job id batch-2026-03-05-09z).
2) Postbacks for warmup events delivered to postback ingestion endpoint and were accepted (ingest logs: s3://redwood-postbacks/prod/2026/03/05/ingest-logs-09z.json).
3) Billing reconciler shows the postbacks were assigned to org_id 92734 in the initial pass but the customer's live org_id is 92734-ALT (legacy internal alias).
4) Finalized invoice lines for 2026-03 show warmup credits absent; reserved-hour lines are present.

Observed behavior: Postbacks from internal probe traffic appear to have been tagged with a stale ledger reference (92734) that maps to a decommissioned cost center. The reconciler suppressed credits for that cost center during invoice finalization, resulting in the customer not receiving credits.

Expected behavior: Warmup credits should be attributed to the customer's active org cost center and reflected on the monthly invoice.

Logs and artifacts:
- Ingest logs: s3://redwood-postbacks/prod/2026/03/05/ingest-logs-09z.json
- Reconciler run (job 2026-03-06T02:00Z): https://kibana.redwood.internal/app/discover#reconciler-run-20260306
- Slack thread: #support > https://slack.redwood.com/archives/C04SUPPORT/p1646789200000
- GitHub PR with tentative fix: github.com/redwood-inference/postback-reconciler/pull/437

Initial hypothesis: A postback normalization change rolled out 2026-03-04 introduced tolerant parsing where legacy alias fields (org_alias) were accepted for attribution; for a subset of internal probe events, the alias mapped to an archived ledger id and the reconciler's dedupe path suppressed later correction passes.

Immediate customer impact and mitigation: Issue is preventing autopay due to invoice balance discrepancy. Customer requested provisional credit while investigation proceeds.

Engineering created follow-up internal ticket INT-90912 to add an invariant check in postback normalization and to add end-to-end test for alias->org resolution. Monitoring set for two billing cycles to verify no regressions.
next_steps: 1) INT-90912 will add unit and integration tests for alias resolution and ensure reconciler does not accept archived ledger ids. 2) Billing Ops will confirm finalized invoice amendment completed and notify customer of final memo. 3) Support to follow up with NimbleHealth on 2026-04-05 to confirm no further discrepancies. 4) Postmortem to be drafted and linked to this ticket once complete.
